intent: An analogy for the shared login: two workers use one shared badge to enter two different buildings (Cloud Run and Agent Runtime). The door log records the badge, the building and the time, but no name, so telling the two workers apart is a guess by building, not proof.

regions.contains: the title top-left, and the 'Analogy' tag at the top-right corner

regions.contains: two worker cards at left, one badge pill in the centre, two building cards at right

regions.occupies: from about 64% to about 84% of the frame height, centred
regions.contains: the door log document with its red 'No name' tag

regions.occupies: from about 87% to about 96% of the frame height, full width inside the margins

elements.label_lines: two lines: 'Building B:' on line 1, 'Agent Runtime' on line 2

text_exact.position: amber badge pill in the centre
upper building card, set on two lines: 'Building A:' then 'Cloud Run'
lower building card, set on two lines: 'Building B:' then 'Agent Runtime'

mandatory: Workers are shown ONLY as rounded cards with a gear icon; no human shapes of any kind
Both worker cards have one arrow into the single amber badge pill; two amber arrows leave the badge, one to each building card
The 'Analogy' tag is clearly visible at the top-right corner
'Badge, building, time' and the bottom bar text are semibold near-black, not light grey
The title is bold, large, top-left and on one line
All text is large enough to read when the image is 1000px wide
The door log never overlaps or touches the bottom bar
Both building labels are set the same way on two lines, breaking only right after the colon: 'Building A:' / 'Cloud Run' and 'Building B:' / 'Agent Runtime'; no other word breaks
Every card, pill, tag and the bar has a visible 2px outline in its colour role's stroke colour
prohibitions: NO human figures, silhouettes, heads, faces, hands or characters; workers are shown only as gear-icon cards
NO third-party logos and NO Google logo
NO 'Vertex AI', 'Agent Engine', 'reasoning engine' or 'reasoningEngines' anywhere
NO project IDs, NO email addresses, NO '@' characters
NO names written inside the door log
NO green anywhere in the image
NO check marks, ticks or crosses
NO text that is not listed in text_exact
NO third worker and NO third building
NO portrait, face, head or person silhouette inside any icon, including the badge icon

alt_text: The title reads: Two workers, one badge, with a tag reading Analogy. Worker A and Worker B, shown as gear icons, both point to one amber card, One shared badge. From the badge, arrows lead to two blue buildings: Building A: Cloud Run and Building B: Agent Runtime. A dashed arrow leads down to a Door log that records Badge, building, time, with a red tag reading No name. A bar across the bottom reads: Guess by building, not proof.
